request.title_buy: We will put together a shortlist for you
request.text_buy: Tell us your budget, preferred area and timing — we will check what is available on the market and send you the options that fit.
request.title_rent: We will find a long-term rental for you
request.text_rent: Tell us your monthly budget, preferred area, move-in date and household — we will send you suitable options.
points: We reply the way you prefer: phone, WhatsApp, Telegram or email
We speak Russian, English and Montenegrin

residency.title: Temporary residence
residency.text: For third-country nationals not covered by the statutory exceptions, property with an official tax valuation of €150,000 or more may serve as grounds for temporary residence, provided the other legal requirements are met. We check the conditions as of the application date — this website is not a substitute for legal advice.
residency.link: Current amendments to the Law on Foreigners

short_term.title: This section is in development
short_term.text: For now we only handle long-term rentals — until the season starts or for a full year. Daily and short-term lets will be added later.

rent_empty.title: The long-term rental catalogue is being connected
rent_empty.text: Rental properties will be published from a separate database that we are connecting now. Until the catalogue goes live we search on request: tell us your budget, area and move-in date and we will send you suitable offers.
points: Until the season starts or for a full year
